train_doppler_separability.data_source: local raw-CSV proxy (A01 frame transform, train interval only)
train_doppler_separability.note: deterministic; no V_select/V_confirm/test times are read; retained-episode retention and recording-overlap ownership are not replicated

decision.condition_b_rule: station_recall or 225-300 m recall spread across -5..20 dB >= 0.05
decision.condition_c_rule: multi-target separation <50% at 40 m/s dvr, or >10% of close train pairs in the E0-only Doppler band
decision.reason: even B8 (M=8, -15.05 dB, 1/32 resources) shows no SNR dependence in -5..20 dB: the plateau is structural (multi-target AoA merging at far range, identical at 20 dB); the B16/B12/B8 candidates additionally lose multi-target Doppler separability
